purpose: Cross-check the 15 fish names printed in Table 1 of Libot et al. (2024) against Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes while preserving the paper's names and separating nomenclature from market-specimen identification, waterbody occurrence and reuse permission.

authority.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
authority.institution: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
authority.accessMethod: Fetched the official exact-genus/species Catalog pages on 2026-10-31. A separate browser-page fetch was intermittently denied with HTTP 403; no login or access-control challenge was bypassed.
authority.reuse: No item-specific permission for bulk or app republication was verified. Only short attributed name-status results and record links are retained.

interpretation.nomenclature: All 15 Table 1 binomials matched an Eschmeyer Catalog record listing that same binomial as currently valid. Three printed author/year strings differ from the checked Catalog: Fibramia amboinensis, Muraenesox cinereus and Johnius borneensis. The source's printed forms remain unchanged; these are candidate citation corrections, not silently applied edits.
interpretation.specimenIdentity: This is a nomenclatural cross-check only. No market fish, photograph, tissue sample, voucher accession or taxon-to-waterbody chain was independently examined.
interpretation.localPresence: Catalog validity, habitat summaries and broad geographic ranges do not establish current occurrence in Butuan, Lake Mainit, Agusan Marsh, the Agusan River or Lumbocan estuary.
interpretation.specialTaxa: The Catalog flags a composite-species/type-history concern for Glossogobius giuris and a possible species complex for Mugil cephalus. Retain both as specimen-level identification caveats.
interpretation.diet: This taxonomy check adds no natural-diet evidence and does not validate the market paper's generalized feeding statements or bait guidance.
interpretation.publication: Name-status checks do not settle source reuse rights. The Butuan article remains research-only with no public-app approval.

limitations: A valid name in a taxonomic catalog does not independently validate the article's field or market identifications.
The source article has no museum voucher accession or specimen-to-waterbody chain in the reviewed account.
The Catalog's habitat and distribution summaries were not converted into local ecological assertions.
Item-specific reuse terms for the Butuan paper and republication of Catalog content remain unverified.
nextAction: Run a bounded read-only GBIF and iDigBio discovery screen for the 15 source labels using Butuan, Lake Mainit, Agusan Marsh, Agusan River and Lumbocan terms. Assess record basis, verbatim/current name, event date, institutional/catalog identifiers and exact locality; distinguish independent specimen vouchers from literature-derived market records and treat zeroes as index limits, not absence.
